claim_one_line: E6 vs E4, AND THE TWO SEEDS (owner directive). 'E4' is real: in the E_n series (del Pezzo / M-theory convention) E5 = D5 = SO(10) rank 5 and E4 = A4 = SU(5) rank 4 -- EXACTLY THE RANK OF THE STANDARD MODEL. The rank bookkeeping of the standard descent: E6 (6) -> SO(10) (5, shedding U(1)_psi) -> SU(5) (4, shedding U(1)_chi) -> SM (4, RANK-PRESERVING via an adjoint VEV). Two consequences explain B952's obstruction: SU(5) -> SM is rank-preserving so a CENTRALIZER CAN do that last step (the cascade is not incapable in general), and the rank reduction lives ENTIRELY in E6 -> SO(10) -> SU(5), which is precisely what B892's headline says the second measurement SKIPS. **SKIPPING SU(5) IS SKIPPING THE RANK REDUCTION**, and the two units the cascade cannot shed are exactly U(1)_psi and U(1)_chi, the standard E6 extra abelian directions -- so the object's u(1)^3 is almost certainly u(1)_Y + u(1)_chi + u(1)_psi (INFERRED from the bookkeeping, testable, NOT established here; L132's panel is scouting it). THE PLUS/MINUS SEED HYPOTHESIS IS CONFIRMED AND ALREADY BANKED: B576 states that any deformation with nonzero theta-odd component has Zariski closure all of E6 and IS CHIRAL while theta-even deformations stay F4-stable and vector-like, and -- in those words -- that THE GEOMETRIC POINT SITS ON THE F4-STABLE (ACHIRAL) STRATUM. So yes: there are two seeds and we are on the one where chiral matter is absent BY CONSTRUCTION (supported by B714's vector-like E6 skeleton, B713's chirality-is-not-in-the-amphichiral-object, and B582 which constructed chiral matter only on the theta-odd twisted mirror-double, i.e. the other branch). THE NEW PART IS THE RANK READING, AND IT IS WORSE NEWS THAN THE HYPOTHESIS: theta is the outer involution and its split is exact, dim E6 = 78 = 52 (theta-even = F4) + 26 (theta-odd), with RANK F4 = 4 = RANK OF THE STANDARD MODEL, and F4 > SU(3)xSU(3) > SU(3)x(SU(2)xU(1)) all at rank 4, while every F4 representation is REAL -- which is exactly why theta-even is vector-like. So THE TWO SEEDS HAVE EXACTLY COMPLEMENTARY DEFECTS: theta-even = F4 at rank 4 (RIGHT RANK) with no chirality (matter absent by construction); theta-odd = full E6 at rank 6 (B952's obstruction) with a complex 27 (RIGHT MATTER). **YOU CANNOT FIX THIS BY CHANGING SEEDS -- each branch is missing precisely what the other has**, and the 'wrong seed' reading suggests a fix by relocation where there is none. WHAT THIS MAKES PRECISE, in one sentence: what is needed is A RANK-REDUCING MECHANISM THAT IS NOT THE THETA-PROJECTION. Theta-projection reduces rank 6 to 4 and KILLS chirality (landing in F4); the GUT chain reduces rank 6 to 4 and KEEPS chirality (landing in SU(5) with a complex 27) but does so by Higgs VEVs, requirement 11 of the GUT ledger, which the object does not supply. L133 is sharpened: not merely 'does the object supply any rank-reducing structure' but 'does it supply one that is NOT theta and that PRESERVES the 27's complexity?', with Wilson line / Hosotani flux the first candidate since the object has a fundamental group and a cusp and the banked literature map records centralizer-of-holonomy as a forced mechanism for the unbroken subgroup. LIMITS: the u(1)^3 identification is inferred not computed; the F4 facts (rank 4, 78 = 52+26, SU(3)xSU(3) in F4, all reps real) are standard Lie theory cited not re-derived, with the arithmetic checked in results.json; nothing is refuted -- B576, B714, B582, B892, B952 all stand; and whether some THIRD structure evades the dichotomy (rank 4, complex reps, neither F4 nor all of E6 -- SU(5) itself is such a thing) is NOT excluded, the point being that the object's own operations do not reach it.
